name: monet-cinema
description: Monet Cinema — a liquid-glass non-linear video editor (Adobe Premiere-class), built on Monet UI with a Rust/WASM compositing engine.

scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @monet-ui/monet-timeline build && pnpm --filter @monet-ui/monet-format build && pnpm --filter @monet-ui/monet-core build && pnpm --filter @monet-ui/monet-react build
scripts.engine:build: cd engine && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --dev
scripts.engine:build:release: cd engine && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release
scripts.build:release: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run engine:build:release && pnpm run build
scripts.setup: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run engine:build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
